text: > ## Documentation Index > Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.heygen.com/llms.txt > Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further. # Changelog > Track every HeyGen API change, new endpoint, deprecation, and version bump in the API changelog. Subscribe via RSS or webhook to get notified on the next. **WebSocket input streaming** Added - November 2026 **Stream text into speech over a WebSocket** Send text in pieces, such as LLM tokens, and receive audio on one connection. Use `/v3/models/audio/tts/stream-input` for one synthesis, or `/v3/models/audio/tts/multi-stream-input` for up to five contexts. Public and instant voices work on all three HeyGen Voice models, including Turbo Free. Browsers connect with a single-use token from [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream-input/tokens`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-speech-input-token). See [WebSocket input streaming](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-speech.md#websocket-input-streaming). **Direct upload to S3** Updated - November 2026 **Upload large files straight to S3, now with its own guide** [`POST /v3/assets/direct-uploads`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-asset-upload) takes video, image, PDF, and SRT files up to 200 MB, audio up to 1.5 GB, and HyperFrames project zips up to 1 GiB. Accepted types include MOV, WebP, HEIC, and WebM audio. Pass `checksum_sha256` to have S3 verify the bytes on upload. See [Direct Upload to S3](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/direct-upload.md), and the [Assets overview](https://developers.heygen.com/assets.md) to pick an upload method. **Speech output formats** Added - November 2026 **Choose the audio format for speech** [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) and [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/stream-speech) accept `output_format`: `pcm`, `mp3`, `ulaw`, or `alaw`, at a sample rate from 8 kHz to 48 kHz. With `output_format`, the stream returns raw audio bytes instead of SSE. See [Output format](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-speech.md#output-format). **Edit Video** Added - November 2026 **Edit a rendered video and re-render only what changed** `POST /v3/videos/{video_id}` changes a video's script text, voice, or avatar engine and motion prompt, keyed by the ids from [`GET /v3/videos/{video_id}/scenes`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-video-scenes). The video keeps its `video_id`, and only the scenes you change render and bill. See [Edit Video](https://developers.heygen.com/edit-video.md). **HeyGen Voice audio tags** Added - November 2026 **Tell a voice how to speak a line** [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) and [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/stream-speech) now accept audio tags in `text`, such as `[whispers]` or `[laughs]`. Public and instant voices perform them on all three HeyGen Voice models. Professional voices do not perform them. 201 tags are supported. See [Audio Tags](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-audio-tags.md). **Cinematic Avatar on HeyGen Video** Added - November 2026 **Render Cinematic Avatar shots with HeyGen Video** [`POST /v3/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-video) with `type: "cinematic_avatar"` now accepts `"model": "heygen_video_1"`. Your avatar looks and their voices become the cast of a HeyGen Video shot: 16:9 or 9:16, 720p, 5 to 15 seconds, with up to 3 audio references alongside images and videos. See [Cinematic Avatar](https://developers.heygen.com/cinematic-avatar.md). **Shared reference-video budget** Updated - October 2026 **Use up to 15 seconds of reference footage across a request** For `reference_to_video` on [`POST /v3/models/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-heygen-video), up to three reference videos share a 15-second input budget. A single video can use all 15 seconds. When the combined footage exceeds the budget, each video keeps up to its first five seconds and the remaining time is shared equally among videos with footage left: two 10-second videos use 7.5 seconds each. `input_video_duration` in submission and polling responses reports the allocated total used for billing. This input budget is separate from output `duration`. See [References and prompt labels](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video.md#references-and-prompt-labels). **Avatar V blinking** Added - October 2026 **More natural blinking for Avatar V** [`POST /v3/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-video) now accepts `"more_blinking": true` in `engine` for Avatar V, for avatars that blink too little. See [Avatar V](https://developers.heygen.com/avatar-v.md). **One brand glossary per workspace** Updated - October 2026 **Update your glossary instead of creating another** [`POST /v3/brand-glossaries`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-brand-glossary) now returns `409 conflict` when the workspace already has a glossary. Existing glossaries keep working. To change rules, update the glossary with [`PATCH /v3/brand-glossaries/{brand_glossary_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/update-brand-glossary). See [Brand Glossary](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/brand-glossary/manage.md#create). **HeyGen Video up to 30 seconds** Added - October 2026 **Longer text-to-video and image-to-video clips** [`POST /v3/models/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video#duration-limits) accepts whole-second durations from 5 to 30 for `text_to_video` and `image_to_video` with `turbo` or `quality` enhancement, at 480p, 768p, 1080p, or 2K. The model ID and endpoint are unchanged. `duration: "auto"` now selects 8–30 seconds for these settings; omitting duration still selects 5 seconds. Reference-to-video, `disabled` or `ultraquality` enhancement, and MCP requests remain limited to 15 seconds. Auto duration respects those limits. See [Duration limits](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video.md#duration-limits). **HeyGen Video auto duration** Added - October 2026 **Let HeyGen Video pick the clip length** [`POST /v3/models/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video) now accepts `"duration": "auto"`. HeyGen picks a length from 8 to 15 seconds based on quoted dialogue, so spoken lines land at a natural pace. The completed job reports the resolved `duration`, and billing uses that length. See [Auto duration](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video.md#auto-duration). **Speech to speech** Added - October 2026 **Speak a recording again in one of your voices** [`POST /v3/models/audio/sts`](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/speech-to-speech) takes a recording of up to 300 seconds and returns the same speech, with the same words and timing, in an instant voice from your workspace. The call returns one WAV. See [Speech to Speech](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/speech-to-speech.md). **Professional voices without a language** Updated - October 2026 **`language` is optional for professional voices** [`POST /v3/models/audio/voices`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-or-retrain-an-audio-voice) in `professional` mode no longer needs `language`. Leave it out and training detects the language of each recording. The voice's `language` is `null` until it is `ACTIVE`. See [Professional Voice Clone](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/professional-voice-clone.md). **HeyGen Voice previews** Added - October 2026 **Listen to a voice before you use it** [`GET /v3/models/audio/voices`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/list-audio-voices) and [`GET /v3/models/audio/voices/{voice_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-an-audio-voice) now return `preview_audio_url` for every `ACTIVE` voice: instant, professional and public. It is a URL to a WAV of the voice reading a short preview script in its language. The URL can expire, so read the voice again rather than storing it. See [Instant Voice Clone](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-instant-clone.md#manage-voices). **Instant voices from an image** Added - October 2026 **Give an instant voice the sound of a setting** [`POST /v3/models/audio/voices`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-or-retrain-an-audio-voice) in `instant` mode now accepts `image`: a picture of the speaker in their setting. The voice takes on the ambience of the image's background, so a quiet room keeps it clean and a busy street adds matching background sound. `image` cannot be combined with `gender` or `age`. See [Instant Voice Clone](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-instant-clone.md). **HeyGen Voice public voices and batch timestamps** Added - October 2026 **Public voices, and character timestamps on completed speech** * [`GET /v3/models/audio/voices`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/list-audio-voices) takes `type`: `private` (default) lists your workspace's voices, and `public` lists HeyGen's public voices. Any workspace can read a public voice with [`GET /v3/models/audio/voices/{voice_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-an-audio-voice) and speak it on [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) and [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/stream-speech). Public voices can't be deleted. * [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) now accepts `with_timestamps`. When `true`, the response adds `original_characters` with the start and end time of each character. See [Character timestamps](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-speech.md#character-timestamps). **Language-specific brand glossary rules** Added - October 2026 **Set pronunciations and forced translations per language** [`POST`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-brand-glossary) and [`PATCH /v3/brand-glossaries`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/update-brand-glossary) now accept `pronunciation_language` on `terms` entries and `target_language` on `forced_translations` entries, as `{ "scope": "specific", "code": "fr" }` or `{ "scope": "all" }`. * Omit the field for an all-languages rule. Existing requests and responses are unchanged. * A language-specific rule takes precedence over an all-languages rule for that language. * The same term can appear once per language in each list. * A term in both `do_not_translate_terms` and `forced_translations` stays untranslated. * See [Brand Glossary](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/brand-glossary/pronunciations.md#per-language-pronunciations). **HeyGen Voice 1 Turbo** Added - October 2026 **Faster, cheaper speech for instant voices** [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) and [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/stream-speech) now accept `"model": "heygen-voice-1-turbo"`. Turbo speaks instant voices at lower latency; `heygen-voice-1` stays the default. Professional voices speak through `heygen-voice-1`. See [Text to Speech](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-speech.md). **HeyGen Voice Instant Clone and Text to Speech** Added - October 2026 **Instant voices on the HeyGen Voice model** [`POST /v3/models/audio/voices`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-or-retrain-an-audio-voice) now takes `"mode": "instant"`: one recording in, a HeyGen Voice `voice_id` out, usually `ACTIVE` within seconds. No training and no voice clone slot. See [Instant Voice Clone](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-instant-clone.md). * `mode` is now required on every create and retrain call: `instant` or `professional`. * List, get, and delete on `/v3/models/audio/voices` cover both kinds; `mode` tells them apart. * [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) and [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/stream-speech) speak instant voices too. `model` defaults to `heygen-voice-1`; `expressiveness_boost` (`0.0`–`1.0`) is instant-only; `seed`, `speed`, `pitch_shift`, `pitch_variance`, and ` ` pauses stay professional-only. See [Text to Speech](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/voices/heygen-voice-speech.md). * Creating an instant voice is free during the preview. **HeyGen Video 1080p** Added - October 2026 **Render HeyGen Video at 1080p** [`POST /v3/models/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-heygen-video) now accepts `resolution: "1080p"` alongside `480p`, `768p` and `2k`. The default stays `768p`. * `1080p` bills at the `2k` rate: 3× the `768p` rate, for output seconds and reference-video seconds alike. * `16:9` returns 1890 × 1080 and `9:16` returns 1080 × 1890. * `text_to_video` and `reference_to_video` render `1080p` in `16:9` or `9:16`, the same as `2k`. Set `aspect_ratio` explicitly for `reference_to_video`, which otherwise defaults to `adaptive`. * `image_to_video` follows the first frame at every resolution. * See [HeyGen Video](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video.md) for the full parameter reference. **Higher rate limits for Enterprise** Changed - October 2026 **Enterprise workspaces get higher request-rate limits** Request-rate limits now depend on your plan. Pay-As-You-Go and subscription limits are unchanged. Workspaces on an Enterprise API plan get higher limits per user and endpoint: * **Read:** 1,000 per minute (was 300). * **Write:** 30 per second (was 10). * **Heavy:** 120 per minute (was 30). * **Status polling:** 1,500 per minute (was 500), and 1,800 per minute per IP address (was 600). * Enterprise workspaces can ask their account team for custom limits on specific endpoints. * A rate-limit `429` now carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and `X-RateLimit-Scope` alongside `Retry-After`. * See [Usage Limits](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/usage-limits.md#rate-limiting) for which endpoints fall in each type and the endpoints with fixed limits. **HeyGen Video 2K** Added - October 2026 **Render HeyGen Video at 2K** [`POST /v3/models/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-heygen-video) now accepts `resolution: "2k"` alongside `480p` and `768p`. The default stays `768p`. * `2k` bills at 3× the `768p` rate, for output seconds and reference-video seconds alike. * `text_to_video` and `reference_to_video` render `2k` in `16:9` or `9:16`. Set `aspect_ratio` explicitly for `reference_to_video`, which otherwise defaults to `adaptive`. * `image_to_video` follows the first frame at every resolution. * See [HeyGen Video](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/models/heygen-video.md) for the full parameter reference. **Create Studio Templates via API** Added - October 2026 **Turn a video into a template and mark what changes, without opening the editor** New endpoints for creating Studio templates over the API. Make one video, promote it to a template, declare its variables, then generate a video per viewer with the existing [`POST /v3/templates/{template_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-video-from-template). * [`POST /v3/templates`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-template-from-video) creates a private template from a video you generated with `POST /v3/videos` or saved in the HeyGen editor. * [`GET /v3/templates/{template_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-template) now returns `composition`, every part of each scene with its `id` and `bindable_as`, plus an `edit_version`. * [`PUT /v3/templates/{template_id}/variables`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/set-template-variables) sets the full variable list. Bind avatars, voices, images, video and audio to a part by `element_id`, and turn exact phrases into `{{name}}` placeholders with `match`. Send `expected_edit_version` to get `409` `stale_edit_version` instead of overwriting a concurrent change. * [`PATCH /v3/templates/{template_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/update-template) renames a template and [`DELETE /v3/templates/{template_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/delete-template) removes it. * Character variables take `avatar_id`. `avatar_look_id` and `character_id` are still accepted. * **Deprecations, removed on October 31, 2026:** the `avatar_look_id`, `character_id` and `character_type` names on character variables (send and read `avatar_id`), and the older `scenes` field on `GET /v3/templates/{template_id}` (read `composition.scenes`). `scene_ids` is unaffected. Until then both names are accepted and echoed, and `scenes` keeps its current shape. * See the new [Create Studio Template via API](https://developers.heygen.com/create-template.md) guide. **HeyGen Video API** Added - September 2026 **Generate a short video from a prompt, a first frame, or reference media** The public API reference now includes [`POST /v3/models/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-heygen-video) and [`GET /v3/models/videos/{video_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-heygen-video) for the `heygen-video-1` model. * Choose `text_to_video`, `image_to_video`, or `reference_to_video` with `mode`. Generate 5–15 second videos at 480p or 768p with a prompt of up to 5,000 characters. * Image-to-video follows the first frame's proportions. Reference-to-video requires at least one image or video and accepts up to nine images, three videos, and three audio recordings, with twelve references total. * Creation returns `202` with a `video_id`. Poll the status endpoint until `completed`, `failed`, or `cancelled`; completed results include a download URL, and unsuccessful results include failure details. * Send an `Idempotency-Key` header when submitting so a retry does not start a second generation. API keys need `videos:write` to create and `videos:read` to poll. **Assets Library Folder Support** Changed - September 2026 **Recognize Assets library folders when reading and placing results** [`GET /v3/folders/{folder_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-folder) documents `asset` alongside `mixed`, `video`, and `video_translate` folder types. Existing Assets library folder IDs are also accepted by routes with a `folder_id` destination. * Assets library folders are created in the HeyGen app and are flat: [`POST /v3/folders`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-folder) cannot create them or nest another folder inside them. * The HeyGen app displays only assets in Assets library folders, so a video or translation placed there may not appear in that view. **Folders on v3** Added - September 2026 **Create folders and file outputs into them over the API** New endpoints: [`POST /v3/folders`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-folder) creates a folder, and [`GET /v3/folders/{folder_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-folder) returns one so a stored id can be checked before use. This is the v3 successor to `POST /v1/folders/create`. * Send `name` (1 to 256 characters) and an optional `parent_id` to nest the folder inside another one. Leave `parent_id` out to create it at the workspace root. Build a tree one level at a time, passing each new `folder_id` as the next `parent_id`. * `type` is `mixed` (the default, same as the web app's New folder action), `video`, or `video_translate`. Every type accepts videos and translations. * Pass the returned `folder_id` on [`POST /v3/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-video), [`POST /v3/video-translations`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-video-translation), [`POST /v3/video-translations/proofreads`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-proofread-session), [`POST /v3/lipsyncs`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-lipsync), or [`POST /v3/templates/{template_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-video-from-template) to place the output in that folder. A `folder_id` outside your workspace is rejected. * Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried create does not leave a duplicate folder behind. **Professional Voice Pause Tags** Changed - September 2026 **Use explicit pauses with a professional HeyGen voice clone** The text input documentation for [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/generate-model-speech) and [`POST /v3/models/audio/tts/stream`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/stream-speech) now clarifies support for ` ` with professional voice clones. Pause values are in seconds, with a maximum of five seconds per pause; other SSML tags and break tags for instant voice clones are unsupported. **Scene-Scoped Edits for Video Agent** Added - September 2026 **Revise the scenes you name and keep the rest** [`POST /v3/video-agents/{session_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/send-message-or-request-revision) now accepts an `edit_plan`: one natural-language change per scene, applied together in a single turn. Untouched scenes keep their script and visuals, so a two-scene fix stays a two-scene fix. * Read scene ids and the document's `edit_version` from [`GET /v3/videos/{video_id}/scenes`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-video-scenes), then send each item with its `scene_id`, `text`, `scene_snapshot_video_id`, and `edit_version`. `message` is optional when a plan is sent. * Works on sessions created in `generate` or `chat` mode. The response returns the new working draft in `video_id`; poll [`GET /v3/videos/{video_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-video) for status. * The whole plan is validated before submission: a scene outside the snapshot returns `400` `invalid_parameter`, and a snapshot that changed since it was read returns `409` `stale_edit_version`. Up to 50 items per request. * See the new [Edit Scenes](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/edit-scenes.md) guide, with a before/after example. **Look Packs over the API** Added - September 2026 **Dress an avatar you already own in a curated set of looks** New endpoint: [`POST /v3/avatars/looks`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-avatar-looks) generates new looks for an existing avatar. Pass one look you own as `reference_look_id` and a curated `template_id`; the results join that look's character. Their ids are returned immediately, but video generation must wait for the looks to finish processing. * `type: "look_pack"` applies a Look Pack, a curated set built around one theme, and the pack decides how many looks it produces. Generation is 16:9, and `aspect_ratio: "9:16"` center-crops the delivered frames to portrait. * `type: "template"` restyles the reference look into a single look template, returning two looks in the template's aspect ratio. * Public templates work for every workspace; enterprise custom packs assigned to a workspace work the same way on this endpoint. * The response returns the character as `group_id` and one id per look. Poll [`GET /v3/avatars/looks/{look_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-avatar-look) until each reports `completed` or `failed`. * Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retry cannot start a second run: a retry while the original is in flight returns `409` `request_in_progress`, and one after it finishes replays the original response. * See the new [Look Packs and Templates](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/avatar-look-packs.md) guide. **Avatar Creation Guides** Changed - September 2026 **One guide per creation path** The Create Avatar guide is now a router into four focused guides: [Video to Avatar](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/avatar-from-video.md), [Photo to Avatar](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/avatar-from-photo.md), [Prompt to Avatar](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/avatar-from-prompt.md), and [Look Packs and Templates](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/avatar-look-packs.md). Each one carries the request, the polling loop, the failure codes, and the render step for that path. [Create Avatar](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/create-avatar.md) keeps the shared response shape and the avatars-versus-looks model. **API Key Introspection, Avatar Default Voice, Housekeeping Endpoints** Added - September 2026 **Inspect your key, set an avatar's default voice, and clean up glossaries and proofread sessions** * [`GET /v3/api_keys/self`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-current-api-key) returns the name, `scope_mode`, `scopes`, and expiration of the key making the request. Works with any key. See [API Key](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/api-key.md#restricting-key-permissions). * [`PATCH /v3/avatars/{group_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/update-avatar-group) sets `default_voice_id` on an avatar you own. See [Avatars](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/avatars.md#get-a-single-avatar-group). * [`DELETE /v3/brand-glossaries/{brand_glossary_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/delete-brand-glossary) removes a glossary. See [Brand Glossary](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/brand-glossary/manage.md#delete). * [`GET /v3/video-translations/proofreads`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/list-proofread-sessions) lists proofread sessions and [`DELETE /v3/video-translations/proofreads/{proofread_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/delete-proofread-session) removes one. See [Video Translation Precision](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/video-translation-precision.md#list-and-delete-proofread-sessions). **Burst Concurrency** Added - September 2026 **Run above your included concurrency on demand** Enterprise workspaces can now turn on burst instead of buying a higher permanent concurrency cap. Set an extra cap of up to +50 under **Capacity → Concurrency** in [Usage](https://app.heygen.com/developers/usage). The cap applies to avatar renders and video translations separately, so [`POST /v3/videos`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-video) and [`POST /v3/video-translations`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-video-translation) each accept requests up to *included + extra* concurrent workflows of their type before returning `429`. * Workflows admitted while every included slot is busy bill at **1.5×** your contract rate; workflows that land in an included slot bill at the normal rate. You only pay the premium for workflows that actually burst. * Burst workflows are tagged **Burst** in the [Activity tab](https://app.heygen.com/developers/usage?tab=activity), and a Burst panel in the Usage sidebar totals the premium for the period. * Burst is shared across the web app and the API. It is enabled per workspace by your account team; see [Burst Concurrency](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/burst.md) and the updated [Usage Limits](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/usage-limits.md#concurrency-limits). **Translation Rules on Brand Glossaries** Added - September 2026 **Set do-not-translate terms and forced translations over the API** [`POST /v3/brand-glossaries`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/create-brand-glossary) and [`PATCH /v3/brand-glossaries/{brand_glossary_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/update-brand-glossary) now accept two translation lists alongside `terms`: * `do_not_translate_terms`: `[{ "term": "HeyGen" }]` keeps each term untranslated in every target language. * `forced_translations`: `[{ "term": "CEO", "translation": "Geschäftsführer" }]` replaces each term with its exact translation, inserted verbatim. * Both lists behave like `terms` on `PATCH`: send a list to replace it, an empty list to clear it, omit it to leave it alone. [`GET /v3/brand-glossaries/{brand_glossary_id}`](https://developers.heygen.com/reference/get-brand-glossary) returns them whenever a glossary has rules, including glossaries set up in the HeyGen app. * The rules apply whenever the glossary is used by a translation feature: over the API on [video translation](https://developers.heygen.com/docs/video-translate.md), and in the HeyGen app when a Studio or Video Agent draft is translated. Plain video generation and text-to-speech use `terms` alone.
